intro.fr: A Robot Named Fight! se joue en multiworld Archipelago depuis 2023, grâce à un mod BepInEx distribué sur le Discord d'Archipelago.
intro.en: A Robot Named Fight! has been playable in an Archipelago multiworld since 2023, through a BepInEx mod distributed on the Archipelago Discord.

text.fr: Morningstar Game Studio sort A Robot Named Fight! en 2017.
text.en: Morningstar Game Studio releases A Robot Named Fight! in 2017.

text.fr: BetaSprite développe l'APWorld du jeu à partir du 7 novembre 2023 ; les derniers changements datent de septembre 2024.
text.en: BetaSprite develops the game's APWorld from November 7, 2023; the latest changes date from September 2024.
